name: France
description: France is a unitary semi-presidential republic and the European Union's second-largest economy. Combining a strong central state with global cultural influence, it leads in aerospace, luxury goods, nuclear energy and agriculture. EU integration, high public investment and a large welfare state shape its coordinated market economy.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of France's actor space from royal manufactures and Napoleonic administration through postwar planning commissions and national champions to EU-embedded regulators and CAC 40 groups.

works.title: Aerospace and Luxury Value Chains
works.description: Network analysis of aircraft assembly, defense procurement, and luxury conglomerates linking provincial production basins to Parisian finance and global retail.

works.title: Metropolitan-Regional Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of metropolitan France's regions, high-speed rail radials, nuclear fleet siting, and the Paris-province economic gradient.
